description: Source file implementing factory classes for various DFT (Discrete Fourier Transform) processors, including generic, FFTW, FFTZ, and AVX2 optimized versions, with functions to create and manage these factories based on system capabilities and configurations.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating generic DFT processor instances.

classes.name: dft_processor_ci16_factory_avx2
classes.description: Factory class for creating AVX2 optimized 16-bit DFT processor instances, enabled on x86_64 architectures.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_fftw
classes.description: Factory class for creating FFTW-based DFT processor instances with specific optimization settings.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_fftz
classes.description: Factory class for creating FFTZ-based DFT processor instances with maximum optimization.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DFT processor instance based on the factory's configuration.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_generic
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a generic DFT processor factory.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftw
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an FFTW-based DFT processor factory with specified optimization and planning parameters.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftz
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an FFTZ-based DFT processor factory.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_ci16_factory_avx2
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an AVX2 optimized 16-bit DFT processor factory if supported.
